name: developer-skill-job-graph
description: Developer Skill & Job Recommendation Graph - a graph-powered job recommendation app backed by CognoDB.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.render:build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
